notes.title: New Death Blonde Gameplay Trailer
notes.content:
A moment of peace, the sun high, everything seems calm… but maybe this isn’t the best place to relax.
Sometimes, it’s better to put on your fashion sunglasses and start handling rockets and explosions.

We’ve put together a new gameplay trailer to mentally prepare you for the Closed Beta coming in May.

[previewyoutube=OktZqcaeSJE;full][/previewyoutube]

If you haven’t signed up yet… maybe it’s time to seriously consider it.
[url=https://forms.gle/vsKta8SWcVAay1qM8]Signup for the Closed Beta[/url]

Demon Girl Team

notes.title: 🕶 From the Shadows to the Light. 🔥
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38682186/fb1d6e8dbeff7d3554735b720aa79692b42ebbb1.png"][/img]
For years, we created, experimented, destroyed, and rebuilt. No one knew who we were. No one knew what we were doing. Not even us. But some of you were already here, watching, waiting, peering into the darkness…

Now, the time has come. The curtain rises.

What we’ve been building is finally ready to be revealed. But this journey isn’t meant to be taken alone. We’re looking for pioneers—players ready to explore with us, share feedback, and get a glimpse of what’s coming next.

🔥 Join us on Discord:  [url="https://discord.deathblondegame.com"]discord.deathblondegame.com[/url]
🔥 Follow us here:
  🔹 X [url="https://x.com/deathblondegame"]x.com/deathblondegame[/url]
  🔹 Instagram [url="https://www.instagram.com/deathblondegame"]instagram.com/deathblondegame[/url]

This is just the beginning. See you on the other side. ⚡[/p]
